scope: local product instruction routing; no personal transfer or public-release claim

pathology.where: skill discovery and entrypoint, developer root guidance, generated task entry
pathology.why: Conditional procedures and phrase-location tests keep unrelated guidance in the entrypoint; local execution permission and finish ownership are less explicit than prohibitions.

rejected_history.lesson: A smaller entry alone does not establish cheaper execution. Keep fast resume self-contained and require measured paired behavior and cost.

evaluation.fast_resume: 4 paired rounds, AB/BA/AB/BA; existing activation evaluator with isolated frozen arm trees
evaluation.development_routing: positive multilingual setup, complete-contract skip, status, permission, ordinary failure and follow-up cases; independent forward evaluation
evaluation.baseline: unchanged champion plus simple retry/selection over its same four completion attempts; count every attempt
evaluation.live_cycle: one additional observed candidate task only after independent provisional acceptance
evaluation.exposure: DEV/VALIDATION only; no retired or sealed holdouts
evaluation.trace_audit: Same closed DEV command grammar for both arms: literal cat, documented Python validators/checks, native edits; unsupported syntax/tool/missing evidence is unknown, never passing. Check resolved paths, fixed checkpoint fields, protected files and worker-owned post-edit completion before independent verification. No OS syscall or arbitrary-shell coverage claim.
evaluation.scope_limits: Model runs exercise fast resume and complete-contract local repair; multilingual routing, setup, conflict, inactive-host and transfer cases remain deterministic/static checks only. No general performance-superiority claim.

acceptance.behavior: Every candidate completion and required permission/conflict field passes; no forbidden fast-resume read or duplicate completion; preserve host and single-writer invariants
acceptance.cost: Median paired input tokens strictly lower; median paired elapsed time no more than 10 percent above champion; all four pairs eligible
acceptance.stop: One frozen candidate; reject and restore changed product surfaces on any required behavior or cost nonpass. NO_PROMOTION on no reproducible advantage. Do not iterate on exposed cases as fresh holdouts. Stop immediately on any nonpass or unknown trace and record attribution before more calls. V1 attempts never contribute correctness or cost credit.
